title: Long-Stay Storage Multiples on Declined and Expired Estimates (Repair Estimates & Appointments)
content:
Footnote to the Repair Estimates & Appointments storage tariff — long stays.

Long stays are billed at a long-stay multiple:

- on a booking whose decline request is confirmed, every billed day after the **7th** billed day is billed at **1.5** times the storage daily rate;
- on a booking in expired status, every billed day after the **7th** billed day is billed at **1.25** times the storage daily rate;
- on every other booking no long-stay multiple applies.

The long-stay multiple applies to the storage daily rate of the statement and only to the billed days after the threshold, the earlier billed days staying at the single rate. A statement of 7 billed days or fewer has no day after the threshold.

| Booking | Billed days 1 to 7 | Each billed day from the 8th |
|---|---|---|
| Customer's decline request confirmed | Single rate | 1.5 times the rate |
| Booking in expired status | Single rate | 1.25 times the rate |

**Worked figures** (hypothetical statement of 10 billed days at a storage daily rate of 60.00 USD)

- Declined: 7 days at 60.00 USD is 420.00 USD; 3 days at 1.5 times 60.00 USD, that is 90.00 USD each, is 270.00 USD; together 690.00 USD.
- Expired: 7 days at 60.00 USD is 420.00 USD; 3 days at 1.25 times 60.00 USD, that is 75.00 USD each, is 225.00 USD; together 645.00 USD.
- Declined, 7 billed days only: no day lies after the 7th, so all 7 days stay at 60.00 USD.

The declined-booking multiple turns on a decline request on the booking that is confirmed; a decline request still pending the customer's confirmation is not a confirmed one.
